title: feat: add GPT-6 Sol and Luna via OpenAI
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds `openai/gpt-6-sol` and `openai/gpt-6-luna` through the direct OpenAI Responses API; no unprefixed aliases or fallback.
- Marks both paid-only with a 1× multiplier and official per-token rates, including the >272K context tier.
- Adds routing and paid-access coverage and updates effective-price snapshots. Gen and Enter typechecks plus focused tests pass; the local `/models` endpoint lists both models.
- Draft pending authenticated end-to-end generation and Tinybird billing-event verification. No new secret or production deployment is included.

gist.headline: Two new suns in the hive
gist.blurb: GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna have landed through OpenAI’s Responses API. Paid builders now have two more celestial brains to point at their strange little ideas.
gist.summary: Added paid-only OpenAI Responses API models `openai/gpt-6-sol` and `openai/gpt-6-luna`, each at a 1× multiplier with official token pricing including the over-272K-context tier, plus routing, permissions, and price coverage.
gist.impact: Developers can select either new prefixed model from `/models` and use it through the existing text API, with paid access and context-tier billing defined explicitly rather than relying on aliases or fallback routing.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy observatory-garden represents the two newly routed OpenAI text models: Sol is a warm pastel sun and Luna a soft lavender moon, each feeding glowing code into a retro terminal. Polli, wearing a tiny astronomer cap, tends code-flowers beneath them while the CRT Monitor Robot eagerly watches the two model constellations appear; the garden and terminal glow prominently lime green.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute bee mascot with a yellow body, dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular cheek blush, a small happy smile, and small rounded light-blue translucent wings, wearing a tiny astronomer cap as she waters lime green (#ecf874) code-flowers in a warm garden observatory; above her, a pastel sun labeled “SOL” and lavender moon labeled “LUNA” send friendly code-stars into a retro CRT terminal while a chunky monitor robot looks delighted. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, subtle scanlines, dark purple (#110518) outlines, emotionally warm and nostalgic.
